paired_design: Both arms receive the same frozen blinded windows and decoded frame sequence.

primary_decomposition.adjudication: hazard precision over the union proposal set
primary_decomposition.end_to_end: human-matched event recall and hazard precision

selection_rule: Reject an arm that fails the common reference gate.
If only one arm passes, retain that arm for the next pilot version.
If both pass without a material calibrated quality difference, retain the lower-cost single-stage arm.
Retain two-stage only if its independent discovery or adjudication benefit is demonstrated rather than assumed.
